ss:prove: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'uv run pytest -q -k "$(printf %s "$SS_SCENARIO" | tr "[:upper:] " "[:lower:]_" | tr -cd "[:alnum:]_")"' --label prove --timeout 900
ss:verify: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'uv run pytest -q -k "$(printf %s "$SS_SCENARIO" | tr "[:upper:] " "[:lower:]_" | tr -cd "[:alnum:]_")"' --label prove --timeout 900 --run 'npx ast-grep scan --rule .shipshape/planks.yml src' --label plank-inventory --timeout 120 --run 'npx ast-grep scan --rule .shipshape/steps.yml tests' --label step-usage --timeout 120
ss:sweep: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'uv run pytest -q -m "not captain and not shipwright"' --label sweep --timeout 900
ss:plank-join: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'npx ast-grep scan --rule .shipshape/planks.yml src' --label plank-inventory --timeout 120 --run 'npx ast-grep scan --rule .shipshape/steps.yml tests' --label step-usage --timeout 120
ss:hygiene: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'npx ast-grep scan --rule .shipshape/planks.yml src' --label plank-inventory --timeout 120 --run 'npx ast-grep scan --rule .shipshape/steps.yml tests' --label step-usage --timeout 120 --run 'uv run mypy src' --label typecheck --timeout 300 --run 'uv run ruff check src tests' --label lint --timeout 300
ss:static: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'uv run pytest --collect-only -q' --label discovery --timeout 300 --run 'uv run mypy src' --label typecheck --timeout 300 --run 'uv run ruff check src tests' --label lint --timeout 300
ss:condemnation: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'uv run mypy src' --label typecheck --timeout 300 --run 'uv run ruff check src tests' --label lint --timeout 300 --run 'uv run pytest -q -k "$(printf %s "$SS_SCENARIO" | tr "[:upper:] " "[:lower:]_" | tr -cd "[:alnum:]_")"' --label prove --timeout 900
ss:dead-code: npx @dk/yoink --max-bytes 200000 --run 'uv run vulture src tests --min-confidence 80' --label dead-code --timeout 300
